The '''''Battle Horn''''' was a [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] produced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which famously served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Battle Horn-class bulk cruiser|''Battle Horn''-class bulk cruiser]] was named after it.
